nodes.description: The splice-site allele removes CFAP70 from the sperm flagellum, and the p.R988X nonsense allele leaves a truncated protein lacking C-terminal tetratricopeptide repeats 5-8. CFAP70 is a structural component of the C2a projection of the central apparatus: in mouse motile cilia, loss of CFAP70, CFAP65 (CCDC108) or MYCBPAP destabilizes the other two and collapses the projection, and in Chlamydomonas the fap70 mutant lacks most of C2a.

evidence.reference_title: Proteomic composition and mutual assembly of the C2a projection in vertebrate motile cilia.
